user.title: PixelIt
user.description: Connect your PixelIt display using its host and matrix dimensions.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure PixelIt
reconfigure.description: Change the display address or matrix dimensions.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the address and that your PixelIt is reachable.
error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname or IP address without a URL or port.

show_message.name: Show message
show_message.description: Show a persistent message and stop the playlist.

message.name: Message
message.description: Enter your text. An optional Gallery icon appears beside it.

color.name: Text color
color.description: Choose a color. Defaults to white. For a clock, sets the clock color.

large_font.name: Large font
large_font.description: Use the large font instead of the small font.

protection_duration.name: Protection duration
protection_duration.description: Seconds during which firmware blocks other content. 0 disables protection. Does not restore previous content.

icon.name: Gallery icon
icon.description: Gallery icon ID. Static and animated icons are detected automatically.

icon_animation_delay.name: Animation speed
icon_animation_delay.description: Milliseconds between frames. Has no effect on static icons.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Effect when content appears. Expanded effects need firmware 3.0.0-beta.1+, vertical slide beta.6+. Saved displays also use it during playlist rotation.

transition_bitmap.name: Bitmap wipe image
transition_bitmap.description: Only for Bitmap wipe: Gallery ID of a static image. Independent of the normal message icon.

icon_rubberbanding.name: Back-and-forth animation
icon_rubberbanding.description: Play animated Gallery icons forwards and backwards. Has no effect on static icons.

icon_limit_loops.name: Animation loop limit
icon_limit_loops.description: 0 repeats indefinitely; a positive count limits playback. Has no effect on static icons. Does not change alert duration.

set_screen.name: Save display
set_screen.description: Store or update a named screen. A playing screen changes on its next turn.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name for this display, for example weather or clock. Use this name in your playlist.

screen.name: Custom screen (YAML)
screen.description: Only for complex displays. Use instead of message or clock. Existing screen objects remain supported.

duration.name: Display duration
duration.description: Seconds per turn in a playlist.

icon.description: Gallery icon ID. Static and animated icons are detected automatically.

color.name: Text color

show_screen.name: Show saved display
show_screen.description: Show a stored screen persistently and stop the playlist.

name.name: Name
name.description: Enter the name of a display you saved previously.

set_playlist.name: Start playlist
set_playlist.description: Save a playlist and start when the display is connected and awake.

screens.name: Screens
screens.description: Add saved display names individually in the desired order. No YAML list needed. An empty list stops playback.

stop_playlist.name: Stop playlist
stop_playlist.description: Stop rotation and any active alert timer, leaving current content visible.

show_alert.name: Show notification
show_alert.description: Temporarily interrupt playback, then show the next playlist screen, last managed content or clock. A new alert replaces the previous alert.

screen.name: Custom screen (YAML)
screen.description: Only for complex displays. Use instead of message or clock. Existing screen objects remain supported.

duration.name: Display duration
duration.description: Seconds after successful transmission before HA resumes managed content.
